connector.name: ThousandEyes MCP
connector.registryDescription: ThousandEyes MCP Server for network intelligence: outages, anomalies, alerts, events, and tests.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.thousandeyes.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.thousandeyes, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: ThousandEyes API token for authentication. Can be either a OAuth Bearer token or a Basic Authentication token.
